**Not as a current assessment.** The June 2025 finding covered 2021–2024, when no tree-cover loss event of at least 0.5 hectares was detected. It did not cover 2025.

The updated assessment identifies a **13.5-hectare tree-cover loss candidate in 2025**, about 3.9% of the property. It is pending corroboration: a later year of observations is needed to assess persistence.

This candidate does not by itself establish deforestation, the cause of the change, legality or regulatory compliance. The due-diligence file should be updated to reflect the new finding and its pending status.
